distribution: Local build only; not installed in personal Zotero or pushed.
changes: Model recommendation and reason are separate from the user selection; recommended checkbox starts unchecked
User may select multiple extra existing personal-library collections, including outside the model suggestion root
Default operation adds only; intake removal requires a separate explicit boolean option
Existing memberships, PDFs and notes are preserved; full selection is validated before atomic save
Manual note import queues a suggestion; completed tasks provide an archive/add-category entry and manual selection without another model call
Selections survive rerenders and same-note recommendation retries; queued manual card cannot suppress the model suggestion
scopeLimit: Native target disappearance and save failures use fault injection; no real-library archiving or real-model classification was performed.
